_about: Attribute specification: everything the generic extractor (extract_eval.py) knows about an attribute is here, not in code. A methodology change is an edit of this file followed by a rerun of the gold scoring. Definitions are WBA's own (gold bases, Metadata Codes, 28 Oct 2026). Fields: name; definition; type (number, percentage, options); unit_family (currency, tco2e); labels (words that name the attribute in a table row or sentence, any language, most specific first); exclude (words that, next to a label, mean another figure: a segment, a subtotal, an intensity); doc_types (document types to read first, in order; others after); period (fiscal_year: WBA's convention, a period ending January to June counts as the previous year); scope (group: the consolidated total, not a segment); xbrl (concepts for the filing routes, sec_facts.py and esef_facts.py); options (multiple-select attributes). The "index" of an attribute (GRI and ESRS disclosure codes, and the words its index rows use) lets the retrieval read the report's own content index for the page the figure is on (content_index.py, 31 Oct 2026). A "variant" (Scope 2) names the basis the attribute wants (location-based or market-based) and whether a figure the report gives without naming a basis is filed under it (default): one such figure goes under location-based only, never under both (31 Oct 2026). status "measuring": added to the evaluation, proposed by propose_values.py only when named (7 Nov 2026). reading_notes: what the model reader is told about what counts and what to prefer, when the definition alone is not enough (31 Oct 2026). more_terms: wording searched in a second, separate query with its own short time limit, and counted as labels on the page; kept out of `labels` because a long phrase list timed out the main search (31 Oct 2026).

GMC_00048.1.name: Revenue
GMC_00048.1.definition: What is the total revenue of the company in the reporting year?
GMC_00048.1.reading_notes: The revenue as the company reports it, in its own reporting currency, not a convenience translation to US dollars. Financial institutions: take the revenue line they report (operating income, net banking income, total income, insurance revenue).

GMC_00001.1.name: Scope 1 emissions
GMC_00001.1.definition: Total scope 1 emissions in tCO2(e) for the reporting year.
GMC_00001.1.reading_notes: Gross emissions for the whole company in tCO2e, not net of offsets or removals. Watch the unit: kt and Mt mean thousands and millions of tonnes, but 'MtCO2e' is sometimes used for metric tonnes; check it against the other figures in the same table.

GMC_00002.1.name: Scope 2 emissions, location-based
GMC_00002.1.definition: Total scope 2 emissions in tCO2(e) location-based for the reporting year.
GMC_00002.1.reading_notes: Gross emissions for the whole company in tCO2e, not net of offsets or removals. Watch the unit: kt and Mt mean thousands and millions of tonnes, but 'MtCO2e' is sometimes used for metric tonnes; check it against the other figures in the same table.

GMC_00003.1.name: Scope 2 emissions, market-based
GMC_00003.1.definition: Total scope 2 emissions in tCO2(e) market-based for the reporting year.
GMC_00003.1.reading_notes: Gross emissions for the whole company in tCO2e, not net of offsets or removals. Watch the unit: kt and Mt mean thousands and millions of tonnes, but 'MtCO2e' is sometimes used for metric tonnes; check it against the other figures in the same table.

GMC_00064.1.name: Low-carbon capital expenditure
GMC_00064.1.definition: What is the total CapEx or investments allocated to climate solutions/enabler activities? (a currency amount or a percentage of total CapEx)
GMC_00064.1.reading_notes: Reports rarely call this 'low-carbon capex'. It counts when the report attributes the capital expenditure or investment to climate solutions, renewable energy, energy efficiency, carbon reduction, decarbonisation, the energy transition, low-carbon products or environmental protection. Prefer, in this order: the EU Taxonomy-aligned CapEx amount (row A.1) when the report prints one; a total of such investments for the year; a single named project only when nothing wider is given. A multi-year budget or a target is not the year's figure.

GMC_01933.1.name: Climate expertise on the highest governance body
GMC_01933.1.definition: What expertises/competences related to climate change and the low-carbon transition are represented among the members of the highest governance body?
options: Recent active membership of relevant organisations

GMC_01936.1.name: Climate policies the company publicly supports
GMC_01936.1.definition: What climate policies does the company publicly support? Paris Agreement commitment; net zero commitment; regional climate policies.

GMC_02526.1.name: Total number of employees
GMC_02526.1.definition: Total number of employees of the company for the reporting year, whole group: the highest employment figure the company reports, including contractors and temporary employees when they are reported (SDG2000 data collection guidance, FY2024 update).
GMC_02526.1.reading_notes: When the report gives several figures (end of year, average, FTE, headcount, permanent only, by region), take the highest figure for the whole group, and prefer a printed total that includes contractors and temporary employees when there is one ('total workforce including contractors'). Give a number the page prints, never a sum you make. A figure for one country or one business is not the group's total.

GMC_00063.1.name: Capital expenditure (total)
GMC_00063.1.definition: Total capital expenditure (CapEx) for the reporting year, in the company's currency.
GMC_00063.1.reading_notes: The company's total capital expenditure for the year: the cash spent on property, plant and equipment and on intangible assets, as in the investing activities of the cash flow statement (purchases or acquisitions of property, plant and equipment and of intangibles), the capex line of the segment note, or the denominator of the EU Taxonomy CapEx KPI. Never a balance: not the carrying amount, net book value, cost or accumulated depreciation of property, plant and equipment at year end, not additions in the fixed-asset roll-forward when a cash-flow capex is printed. Not a segment, not guidance or a plan, not the taxonomy-aligned part.
labels: purchase of property, plant and equipment
purchases of property, plant and equipment
acquisition of property, plant and equipment
additions to property, plant and equipment
investments in property, plant and equipment

GMC_00005.1.name: Scope 3 emissions
GMC_00005.1.definition: Total scope 3 emissions in tCO2(e) for the reporting year.
GMC_00005.1.reading_notes: Total scope 3 (value chain, indirect) emissions for the whole company in tCO2e: the sum over the categories the company reports. Not one category, not scope 1, 2 or 3 together.

GMC_00124.1.name: Scope 1 + Scope 2 emissions
GMC_00124.1.definition: Total scope 1 and scope 2 emissions together in tCO2(e) for the reporting year.
GMC_00124.1.reading_notes: Scope 1 and scope 2 emissions added together, for the whole company, in tCO2e, as the report prints the total. Not scope 1 alone, not including scope 3.

GMC_00047.1.name: R&D spending (total)
GMC_00047.1.definition: Total research and development spending for the reporting year, in the company's currency.
GMC_00047.1.reading_notes: The company's total research and development expense or spending for the year, as in the income statement, its notes or the management report (the R&D line, or total R&D spending including the part capitalised when the report prints that total). Not R&D as a percentage of revenue, not a single programme or segment, not capitalised development costs alone, not amortisation of capitalised development, not R&D tax credits or headcount.

_about_siblings: siblings: attributes whose figure is printed on the same page or next to it (2 Nov 2026, 331 company-years: Scope 1 and Scope 2 on the same page 89 to 93% of the time, revenue and low-carbon capex 46%, within two pages 70%). The sibling's best page is found first and the attribute's pages there and next to it score higher (extract_eval.sibling_pages).
